entries.preview: M3351 flash access: DP must be powered down during nRESET; use tools/flash.py --program --halt-at-reset-vector --boot
entries.content: Established 2026-10-29 for the NuMaker M3351KJCAE (probe 13010000003800F1047546CF0000065D): the "LOCKUP / FAULT / DAUTHSTATUS=0xAF" state was not a security lock. Interrupted programming had erased APROM page 0, so the Secure Bootloader stayed in ROM; while a debugger keeps the DP powered across reset the ROM leaves secure debug disabled and all bus accesses fault. Fix: power the DP down (dp.power_down_debug) during the nRESET pulse and reconnect a few ms later. Repeatable programming entry: FPB breakpoint on APROM Reset_Handler + C_DEBUGEN, DP down during reset, DP up 50 ms later -> core halts in Secure privileged Thread on MSP, VECMAP=0, so all tools/flash.py guards pass. Implemented as `tools/flash.py --program --halt-at-reset-vector --boot`; run only through the arbitrated flash tool. Never use pyocd under-reset/reset-halt or the pack DebugPortStart sequence on this part. If page 0 is invalid again: case scripts rom_window_timing -> halted_sde_check -> preflight_config -> vecmap_restore_backup (volatile VECMAP 0x2E to 0). Full 1 MiB APROM/LDROM/Data Flash/CONFIG backups in .embedder/backups. Embedder serial provider does not enumerate the Nu-Link VCOM; use cases/m3351-flash-lockup/boot_and_observe.py (pySerial) for UART0 boot captures. Open item: macOS shows J3 device !registered/!matched with no CDC interfaces (also for upstream cdc_acm sample).

entries.preview: M3351 CDC ACM IN-endpoint wedge = untrimmed HIRC USB clock; fix is USB-SOF HIRC trim in src/usb.c (hirc_trim_arm), pending HIL
entries.content: 2026-10-30: On numaker_m3351ki the J3 CDC ACM port (/dev/cu.usbmodem1101) wedged deterministically after specific 37-byte FC3 replies (data 6789 789A 89AB 9ABC ABCD): macOS logged endpoint 0x89 status 0xe00002ed (transaction error), libusb got EIO/EPIPE, clear_halt did not recover, only close/reopen did. OUT direction unaffected. Root cause: dts/arm/nuvoton/m335x.dtsi never enables hxt, so PLL comes from HIRC/4 and USBD runs from raw 48 MHz HIRC; udc_numaker.c explicitly does not trim HIRC and nothing in Zephyr enables SYS_HIRCTCTL auto-trim (TRM 6.2.10). Untrimmed RC exceeds FS USB ±0.25%, long IN packets fail CRC at host, controller retransmits forever. Fix: src/usb.c hirc_trim_arm() writes SYS_HIRCTCTL REFCKSEL=1 (USB SOF), RETRYCNT=3, LOOPSEL=3, FREQSEL=01 on USBD_MSG_RESET/CONFIGURATION/RESUME (hardware clears FREQSEL when SOF absent). Built (server e77479bd…) but NOT programmed/verified because the Nu-Link2-Me stopped enumerating (no 0416:2004); re-seat ICEJ2 cable, program with tools/flash.py --program --halt-at-reset-vector --boot, then run cases/m3351-flash-lockup/rtu_scenarios.py (full10/last5 must pass) and rtu_acceptance.py. Diagnostic scripts: rtu_wedge_direction/hostlog/libusb/dtr_recovery.py.
